question.worked_solution:
Notice that all of the terms have a common factor of $4.$ Therefore, we can simplify the expression by factoring out $4,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4{r}^{2}+16r+16 & = \\ 4({r}^{2}+4r+4)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, let's factor the expression inside parentheses using the square of a sum formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{2}+4r+4 & = \\ {r}^{2}+4r+{2}^{2} & = \\ {r}^{2}+2\cdot 2r+{2}^{2} & = \\ (r+2)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, our original expression factors as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4({r}^{2}+4r+4) & = \\ 4(r+2)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
